title: Scroll Seal — payload
description: A mage's κ evidence bundles, by root and location, to be sealed as one scroll on its mages.city subdomain. The response ($defs.Response) is the scroll's address and the count of hashes sealed.

scroll.description: The scroll id, which is also its subdomain label by default.

domain.description: OPTIONAL. The subdomain to publish at. Absent means <scroll>.mages.city, or the domain already registered for this scroll.

bundles.description: The bundles, one book each, in book order (I to X).

root.description: The bundle's sha256 root (root.json root_kappa, without the sha256: prefix).

blake3.description: OPTIONAL. The bundle's BLAKE3 root, where minted.

mintedOn.description: The day the bundle was minted (root.json minted_on).

location.description: Where the City fetches the bundle from: an HTTPS URL of the bundle directory.

books.description: How many books the scroll now holds.

sealed.description: How many hashes this seal joined to the ledger (objects, edges and roots).
